title: Immunity
wikitext:
'''Immunity''' [[File:Immunity.png|24px]] is a statistic that affects your chance to be afflicted with any [[Buffs|debuff]]. It has no effect on the length of time that you are invulnerable after getting damaged. Each point of Immunity reduces the probability of being debuffed by 9.1%, additively. For example, when wearing the Genie Shoes, which provides 6 points of Immunity, the chance of being debuffed is reduced by 55%. If wearing equipment that provide sufficient total Immunity (+11 or more), the player can stay completely free from any debuffs. ==Equipment== The following equipment affects Immunity.
